known_issues: Music is not working on the deployed site
User photo is missing/not displayed on the site

existing_features.title: Fix the landing page photo so the user’s photo reliably displays in production, rather than failing to load from the current Google Photos share URL (https://photos.app.goo.gl/UswyaKrbtbzie7AQ8). Use a local static photo asset as the primary source when present, and keep a graceful fallback to the existing placeholder image (/assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_1024x1024.png) if the local photo is missing or fails to load.

Fix the landing page music player so the track loads and plays reliably in production using the local static audio file path currently referenced by the app (/assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3). Add user-visible error handling so that if the audio file cannot be fetched/decoded, the UI clearly indicates the track failed to load and suggests refreshing or checking the asset path.

Ensure all required static media assets are present in the frontend build output under the public static assets path so that the deployed site can fetch them via absolute URLs: (1) the user photo asset and (2) the MP3 file.

projectName: Fix missing photo and non-working music on landing page
